Case No. 3427 of 2012 (arising out of Mahila PS Case No. 15 of 2012) whereby, learned Sub- Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Katihar acquitted the Respondents No. 2 to 6 from the charges punishable under Patna High Court CR.
3. This petition has been filed by the petitioner on 25.03.2019.
